entities.name: Orthion
entities.description: A human soldier from Ikoria, legendary Captain and Hero of Lavabrink who fought with a long spear.

entities.name: Lava Serpent
entities.description: A resident lava monster who helped Orthion hold back the Phyrexians at the Lavabrink Floodgates.

entities.name: Lavabrink Floodgates
entities.description: The site where Orthion fought the Phyrexian hordes.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion in which Orthion defended Ikoria.

events.summary: Orthion fights at the Lavabrink Floodgates alongside the Lava Serpent and another lava monster to hold back the Phyrexian hordes.
events.quote: he fought at the Lavabrink Floodgates

relations.note: They held back the Phyrexians together.
relations.quote: he collaborated with the resident Lava Serpent
hold back the relentless Phyrexian hordes
